images.alt_text: Business failures define golden sets and separate tool, agent and orchestration evaluations; merge and release gates lead to production checks whose evidence feeds later tests.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Failures define golden sets feeding experiments and gates; production evidence returns to golden sets through feedback. Threshold controls feed both gates; the separate tool/agent/orchestration stack shows evaluation scopes. Gate internals visibly show input checking and result comparison. Rejected candidate 1 for three omitted level labels. Candidate 2 includes all18 labels and a three-level evaluator stack; final saved1200x630 pixels reviewed individually. Abstract document symbols are not pseudo-writing.

images.alt_text: An open-weight coding model exposes precision, memory, cache, sharding and pinned-runtime choices across three deployment alternatives, followed by quality and load testing and cleanup.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Open weights expose deployment choices; precision, memory and runtime must be pinned and tested. Candidate1 rejected for reverse custom-serving arrow and insufficient top margin. Candidate2 presents three outward alternative deployment branches, expanded margins and precision-to-quality-check link. Final pixels inspected; all17 labels present and legible. Exploded layer connections are conceptual dependencies, not actual hardware engineering dimensions.

images.alt_text: Isolated AI tasks contrast with a connected process supported by trusted customer, contract and inventory data, governance, approval, compliance and accountable outcome testing.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Task-level AI use is not end-to-end readiness; connected data and governed processes support controlled workflow trials. Candidate1 rejected for realistic rocky scenery and foliage filler. Candidate2 removes scenery in favor of clean conceptual paper/slab foundations. Final pixels reviewed:14labels correct, decision/trial deck and exception branch coherent, data and governance groups correctly associated. No numerical survey claims or guaranteed outcome.

images.alt_text: A board evidence folio groups accountable decisions, residual risk and supplier dependencies with a combined incident and recovery exercise leading to tracked actions, retesting and closure evidence.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Board oversight needs accountable decisions, residual-risk visibility and tested recovery evidence rather than security assurances alone. Candidate1 extra unapproved heading and false incident-to-continuity sequence rejected. Candidate2 removed extra heading but retained unwanted arrow. Candidate3 replaces all arrows within resilience grouping with nondirectional brace; preserves exercise-to-open-actions and retest/conditional-closure path. Final exact saved PNG reviewed; labels complete and legible.

images.alt_text: A bounded agent task sits within scope, identity and external-policy controls, with reconstructable traces and separate channels for rule proof under stated assumptions and ambiguous human judgment.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Bounded autonomy combines scope, identity, external policy and observability; proof applies to stated rules, ambiguity still needs judgment. Candidate1 rejected because dashed denial-to-ambiguity link conflated different concepts. Candidate2 removes that link and explicitly routes ambiguity to human judgment separately. All18labels and final1200x630pixels reviewed; proof remains paired with stated assumptions rather than blanket guarantee.

images.alt_text: A portable expense-precheck Skill loads instructions and resources, gates script execution through approval, tests fixtures and returns findings without filing or reimbursement.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: A portable skill progressively loads instructions and resources; a read-only expense precheck keeps script execution gated and stops before filing. Candidate1 rejected for duplicated resource labels and clipped package. Candidate2 replaces duplicate resource trays with geometric positive/negative fixtures and increases margins. Final saved PNG reviewed:16unique labels complete, approval precedes checks, outcomes converge to findings terminating at no-filing boundary.

set_review.differentiation_evidence: Six saved final PNGs and an actual six-set contact sheet were inspected. They use a lifecycle ribbon and evaluator stack; exploded configuration chassis and three deployment alternatives; process bridge on governed-data foundations; unfolded board-evidence folio; cutaway concentric autonomy controls; and an exploded Skill package with approval-gated read-only test bench. Their primary grammars, hierarchy, object families, annotation patterns and dominant palettes differ.
